name: Rábatamási (Hungary)
description: White field with a row of red triangles along the top edge and a row of green triangles along the bottom edge, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Rábatamási: a crowned black and blue shield with yellow stars, a white bird and a red charge, above a scroll inscribed RÁBATAMÁSI.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Rábatamási arms with crown and scroll
